title: Ukrainian Corn and Pilaf Delight
description: A simple and flavorful dish from Ukraine, combining the richness of pilaf with the sweetness of corn. Perfect for a light lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of mildly flavored vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the Ukrainian pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the corn kernels and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pilaf is lightly toasted.
